title: Paths
statementMd:
You are given a positive integer $*n*$. Let's build a graph on vertices $1, 2, ..., *n*$ in such a way that there is an edge between vertices $*u*$ and $*v*$ if and only if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a9f8cfef2277cc8f4fc17d13f965e877c0eaed30.png). Let $*d*(*u*, *v*)$ be the shortest distance between $*u*$ and $*v*$, or $0$ if there is no path between them. Compute the sum of values $*d*(*u*, *v*)$ over all $1 ≤ *u* < *v* ≤ *n*$.

The $*gcd*$ (greatest common divisor) of two positive integers is the maximum positive integer that divides both of the integers.

## Input

Single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{7}$).

## Output

Print the sum of $*d*(*u*, *v*)$ over all $1 ≤ *u* < *v* ≤ *n*$.

## Note

All shortest paths in the first example:

- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7b7a110945393c2b47718b811aadf12cbe125f3f.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e9af98cb64a31b6dae850dbfb30429b9a091c123.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d43a3ea9a040a07b650cc4d74a5f6a69395d0005.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1725357f3b9d9284226b8c2848aab916720da24f.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e05d0e132bba9db531dc61149062e6f9f5ff34a.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/043fdd1108540c9fbac49c9177d6ec0021cbd896.png)

There are no paths between other pairs of vertices.

The total distance is $2 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 = 8$.
statementZhMd:
给定一个正整数 $*n*$。我们在顶点 $1, 2, ..., *n*$ 上构造一个图：当且仅当 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a9f8cfef2277cc8f4fc17d13f965e877c0eaed30.png) 时，顶点 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$ 之间存在一条边。令 $*d*(*u*, *v*)$ 表示 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$ 之间的最短距离；如果两者之间不存在路径，则令其为 $0$。请计算所有满足 $1 ≤ *u* < *v* ≤ *n*$ 的点对的 $*d*(*u*, *v*)$ 之和。

两个正整数的 $*gcd*$（最大公约数）是能够同时整除这两个整数的最大正整数。

## 输入格式

一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{7}$）。

## 输出格式

输出所有满足 $1 ≤ *u* < *v* ≤ *n*$ 的点对的 $*d*(*u*, *v*)$ 之和。

## 说明

第一个样例中的所有最短路径：

- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7b7a110945393c2b47718b811aadf12cbe125f3f.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e9af98cb64a31b6dae850dbfb30429b9a091c123.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d43a3ea9a040a07b650cc4d74a5f6a69395d0005.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1725357f3b9d9284226b8c2848aab916720da24f.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e05d0e132bba9db531dc61149062e6f9f5ff34a.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/043fdd1108540c9fbac49c9177d6ec0021cbd896.png)

其他顶点对之间不存在路径。

距离总和为 $2 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 = 8$。
